lines.text: Lena's first night out. Warm bag, thin summer pad.
The cold is coming up from the ground,
and a bag squashed under you can't hold heat.
Here's the fix. Your pad matters as much as your bag.
Pick a pad made for cold ground,
and a bag rated colder than the forecast low.
Sleep in dry layers and a hat.
Next time, Lena sleeps till sunrise.
Save this before your first night out.
